## EXCLUSIVE FIRST LOOK: the NEW Sleep Number® app


This November, the SleepIQ® app is advancing so you get even more from your smart bed. Delivering a one-of-a-kind experience, seamlessly blending smart bed capabilities, personalized insights, rewards and customer service, for even smarter sleep. Get a sneak peek of the new app below!


*Like diet and exercise, quality sleep is essential for optimal wellbeing and performance. Because everyone's sleep needs are different,*[Sleep Number® smart beds](https://selectcomfort.sharepoint.com/sites/MediaTeam/Shared%20Documents/General/categories/mattresses) *sense your movements and automatically adjust firmness, comfort and support to keep you both sleeping comfortably. Find your*[Sleep Number® setting](https://support.sleepnumber.com/hc/en-us/articles/230551727-How-to-find-your-Sleep-Number-settingsleepiq-sleep-tracker) *for your best possible night's sleep.*
